layers.name: START_HERE
layers.purpose: Workflow, pin, context budget, limits, tool routes (CLI and plain filesystem).

layers.name: INDEX
layers.purpose: Every node type and relationship type on one line, grouped by domain; modules; counts.

layers.name: domains
layers.purpose: Navigational domain: purpose, questions, modules, node types, internal relationships, seams, tasks.

layers.name: modules
layers.purpose: Release module (assembly manifest): owner, digest, definitions, relationship types, predicates, questions.

layers.name: cards
layers.path: nodes/ relationships/ edge-properties/ interfaces/ unions/ predicates/ assessments/ vocabularies/
layers.purpose: One element with generated front matter: identity, fields, relationships, predicates, evidence path, temporal rules, write route.

layers.name: sdl
layers.purpose: Verbatim SDL definition from the pinned release.

layers.name: tasks
layers.purpose: Task routes: elements, read operations, proposal kinds (pending kinds marked), steps, pitfalls.

layers.name: rules
layers.purpose: Identity, ingestion, temporal, projection and evidence-path rules of the release.

layers.name: patterns
layers.purpose: Question-linked Cypher 5 templates with parameters, output contracts, temporal/provenance notes and status.

layers.name: migrations
layers.purpose: v1 -> v2 navigation (old ids as aliases, removed concepts explained); never execution scripts.

layers.name: search
layers.purpose: Machine authority: one JSON record per card (filterable fields) and the schema topology.

layers.name: schema-ir
layers.purpose: The full IR v2 (large; read with jq / ConvertFrom-Json, not whole).

analytics.gds-aga.reason: OD-22: optional capability; no required DDL or supported template depends on it

chunk.write.reason: the live shared Knowledge Services Enterprise constraints on :Chunk (chunkId, chunkKey, index, text NOT NULL; chunkId/chunkKey unique) conflict with the v2 D9 Chunk shape; they belong to another authority and are not dropped or modified; v2 Chunk writes are unsupported in this release

graphql.mutations.reason: L2 (OD-02): no Mutation root; writes go through the native executor

legacy.nodes.reason: LegacyV0 / LegacyV0_<Label> nodes, MIGRATED_FROM edges and legacy: qualifiers exist after the migration; they are excluded from the consumer projection, typed reads and catalog templates

vectors.native.reason: OD-44: ddl/optional.cypher records the text-embedding-3-small/1536/cosine profile; not created or served in this release; the catalog templates that need the vector index (D9/Q-D9-20#vector, QP/P-04a) are unsupported with requires: [vectors.native] and excluded from the supported count

semantic.note: Semantic/hybrid schema search is wired by S5 (OpenAI Vector Stores). Until a generation is bound, semantic requests return an explicit unavailable status and hybrid degrades to lexical-only.
